DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スープをこぼしました。私の卓だけでなく、隣の椅子の方まで流れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: スープが隣の椅子まで流れたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spilled soup. It's run beyond my table as far as the chair next to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the soup has reached the neighboring chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: やけどをされた方はいませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今のところ私は大丈夫です。隣の方の上着にかかったかは、まだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自身の状態と他人の上着への付着未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm all right so far. I haven't yet checked whether it got on the person next to me's jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your condition and that you have not confirmed whether it got on another person's jacket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで片付けます。熱い器から離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll clean it up. Please wait away from the hot bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の手拭きで急いで広げず、濡れた場所を先にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で広げず濡れた範囲を係へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Rather than hastily spreading it with my own hand towel, I'll first show you the wet areas.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the staff the wet area without spreading it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路の床にも落ちていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has any fallen onto the floor in the passage?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し落ちています。ほかの方が踏まないよう、係の方に来ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路の床の濡れと通行人への確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: A little has. I'd like a staff member to come so nobody steps in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the wet passage floor and request staff attention to people passing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 床と椅子を確認し、別の席へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the floor and chair and show you to another seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。隣の方の持物は勝手に触らず、かかった可能性があることを店の方から伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他人の物に触れず店から状況確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't touch the other person's belongings without asking. Please tell them that the soup may have got on their things.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the restaurant to check the situation without touching another person's belongings yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで隣のお客様にも状況を伺います。床を片付けた後、安全な席へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll ask the neighboring customer about it too. After cleaning the floor, we'll take you to a safe seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で分からない欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any fields on the medical questionnaire you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜は夜勤でした。ほとんど寝ずに来たことを、どこに書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤明けで睡眠不足と記入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I worked a night shift last night. Where should I write that I've come here with almost no sleep?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are short of sleep after a night shift and ask where to write it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日の体調欄に書けます。今、具合の悪いところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write it in today's condition field. Do you feel unwell anywhere now?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し眠いですが、胸の痛みや息苦しさはありません。眠気だけと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の眠気とない症状を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm a little sleepy, but I have no chest pain or difficulty breathing. I'd like to explain that it's just sleepiness.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the current sleepiness and the symptoms you do not have. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状態を健診担当へお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll let the health-check staff know about your condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。検査の数値が出る前から、夜勤のせいだと決めつけるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 数値の原因を先に断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't intend to decide that the night shift caused the results before the test values even come out.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not determine the cause of the values in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に食事をした時刻も記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also enter the time you last ate.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前二時です。飲んだものは水だけですが、検査条件に合うかは担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事時刻と飲水を伝え条件確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was two in the morning. I've only drunk water, but I'd like the person in charge to check whether that meets the test conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the meal time and water intake and ask to check the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食事時刻と夜勤明けの状態を確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's have them check your meal time and your condition after the night shift.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。問診票に正確に書き、今日実施できる検査を説明してもらってから進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入後に実施可能な検査を担当へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll fill in the questionnaire accurately and proceed after they explain which tests can be done today.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After filling it in, ask the staff which tests can be performed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 体調欄と食事時刻をご記入ください。検査の可否は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please fill in the condition field and meal time. The staff will check whether the tests can proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父の写真に昔の道具が写っています。この展示の道具と同じものか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族写真の道具と展示の照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: An old tool appears in a photo of my grandfather. I'd like to know whether it is the same as the tool in this exhibition.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to compare a tool in a family photo with the exhibit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を見せていただけますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。撮影年は分かりますが、道具の名前は家族も覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真と判明している年および不明な名称を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. We know the year it was taken, but nobody in my family remembers the tool's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the photo and explain the known year and unknown name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 似ていますが、写真だけでは同じ種類と断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: They look similar, but we can't conclude from the photo alone that they are the same kind.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。似ている点と、違いを調べる資料を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 類似点と調査資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Could you explain the similarities and tell me about materials for researching the differences?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about similarities and research materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示の解説と、閲覧できる参考図書があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are the exhibit description and reference books available to consult.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 解説の名称をメモしてから図書を見ます。写真を展示品の説明として勝手に公開はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名称を記録し写真を説明資料として公開しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the name in the description before looking at the books. I won't publish the photo as an explanation of the exhibit on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the name and explain that you will not publish the photo as explanatory material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を閲覧する場所へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you where you can consult the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。分からなかった部分は不明と残し、家族にも確実なことと推測を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明点を残し家族へ確実性を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll leave anything unresolved marked as unknown and distinguish facts from guesses when I tell my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave unknowns unresolved and distinguish levels of certainty when explaining to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの閲覧机をご利用ください。道具の名称を探す相談として担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this reading desk. I'll connect you with the person who can help you look for the tool's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の受取でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在票が二枚あります。両方ともここで受け取れると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の不在票を一緒に受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two missed-delivery notices. I came thinking I could collect both here.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can collect the parcels for two notices together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 各票の受取場所を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the collection location on each notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。差出人が違うので、荷物も別々です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の差出人の荷物と票を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. The senders are different, so they are separate parcels too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the notices for parcels from different senders. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一枚はこの窓口、もう一枚は別の場所を示す設定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: One is assigned to this counter, and the other indicates another location.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では一緒には受け取れませんね。こちらの分だけ、今受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定先の違いを理解しこの窓口分だけ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I can't collect them together. Can I collect just the one for this counter now?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different locations and request only the parcel for this counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保管状況を番号で確認します。本人確認資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check its storage status using the number. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードを持っています。別の票の番号を、こちらの荷物の番号と混ぜないよう分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人資料を提示し追跡番号を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card. I'll keep the other notice separate so I don't mix its number with this parcel's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present identification and keep the tracking numbers separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの荷物は用意できました。別の票はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This parcel is ready. I'll return the other notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。別の荷物は票の受取先へ確認します。二枚とも受取済みにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未受取の荷物は指定先へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the other parcel with the collection location on its notice. Please don't mark both as collected.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check the uncollected parcel with its designated location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この一件だけ受取を記録しました。もう一枚は、指定先の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've recorded collection of just this one. Please check the instructions for the designated location on the other notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to make a deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。お札を数えましたが途中で話しかけられ、金額に自信がなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 数えた金額に自信がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I counted the banknotes, but someone spoke to me partway through and now I'm not sure of the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure of the amount you counted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ入金処理はしていません。こちらで数えて、金額をご確認いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't processed the deposit yet. We'll count it here and ask you to confirm the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。自分のメモは七万円ですが、その額に合わせて処理しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分のメモ額を確定額として扱わないと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. My note says seventy thousand yen, but please don't process it just to match that amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them not to treat your noted amount as confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数えたところ六万円でした。メモとの差があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've counted sixty thousand yen. That differs from your note.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の数え間違いかもしれません。残りを財布に入れたか、ここで見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差額を受け財布の残りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I may have miscounted. May I check here whether I put the rest in my wallet?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Respond to the difference by checking the remaining money in your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の財布をご確認ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一万円が残っていました。これも入金したいので、先ほどの分と合わせて数えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加現金を合わせて再計数してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was ten thousand yen left. I'd like to deposit this too, so please count it together with the earlier amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to recount the additional cash together with the original cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合わせて七万円です。この金額で入金してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That makes seventy thousand yen. May I deposit this amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、七万円でお願いします。処理後の控えでも金額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した金額で入金し控えを照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, seventy thousand yen, please. I'll check the amount on the receipt after processing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Deposit the confirmed amount and check the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 七万円で入金しました。こちらが控えです。金額をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've deposited seventy thousand yen. Here is your receipt. Please check the amount.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入浴券をお持ちですね。お入りになる前に、確認したいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a bathing ticket. Is there anything you'd like to check before going in?

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この券で入るつもりです。タオルは中で受け取れると思って、何も持ってきませんでした。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入浴券で利用するがタオルは中で受け取れると思い持参していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm planning to use this ticket. I thought I would receive a towel inside, so I didn't bring anything.
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you will use a bathing ticket but brought no towel because you expected one inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券面には入浴券とだけ書かれています。タオルの表示は、こちらの売場に別に出ています。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-03.translation: The ticket only says bathing admission. Towels have a separate sign here in the sales area.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: タオル付きの券だと思っていました。この表示は借りる物ですか、それとも持ち帰れる物ですか。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券にタオルが含まれると思っていたと説明し、別の表示が貸出か販売か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the ticket included a towel. Does this sign refer to something to borrow or something I can take home?
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you expected a towel to be included and ask whether the separate sign means rental or sale. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは販売用のタオルという表示です。お手元の券に含まれる物とは分けてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-05.translation: This sign says towels for sale. Please consider them separately from what your ticket includes.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分のタオルは宿に置いてきました。取りに戻るか迷っていますが、今日はここで一枚買いたいです。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私物のタオルは宿にあり、取りに戻る案もあるが今日は一枚購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I left my own towel at my accommodation. I'm wondering whether to go back for it, but today I'd like to buy one here.
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your towel is at your accommodation and that although you could return for it, you want to buy one today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お求めになる品をこちらでご確認ください。購入する前に、表示について読みにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please check the item you want here. Is any of the information difficult to read before you buy?

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい方を一枚にします。入浴券とは別に支払うということですね。タオルの分の金額を、ここで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小さいタオル一枚を選び、入浴券と別払いであることと当該価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take one small towel. That means I pay for it separately from the bathing ticket, right? I'd like to check the towel's price here.
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one small towel and confirm the separate payment and its price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、別のお支払いになります。この品の価格はこちらです。こちらの表示でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it is a separate payment. This is the price for this item. Is this information clear?

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を確認しました。このタオルを一枚買ってから入ります。券だけで受け取れる物ではないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を読んで一枚の購入を決め、入浴券だけでは受け取れないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the sign. I'll buy one of these towels before going in. I understand it isn't something I receive with the ticket alone.
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After reading the sign, decide to buy one and confirm that the bathing ticket alone does not provide it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。タオルのお会計はこちらで伺います。入浴券もなくさずお持ちください。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-OIT-BEPPU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We'll take payment for the towel here. Please keep your bathing ticket safe too. Please come to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約の確認画面と、お泊まりになる人数を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. May I see your booking confirmation screen and ask how many people will be staying?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約はこちらです。今ここに来ているのは私一人ですが、同行者は後で来ます。人数は一人と答えればよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約を示し、現時点は自分一人だが同行者が後で来るため人数の答え方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here is my reservation. Only I am here now, but my companion will come later. Should I answer one person?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the reservation and ask how to give the number since you are alone now but your companion will come later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いらっしゃる人数ではなく、お泊まりになる方の人数を確認しています。同行の方も、同じご予約でお泊まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're checking the number staying, rather than the number here now. Is your companion staying under the same reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、二人で泊まります。部屋は一つです。一室という文字を見て、人数も一人かと混同しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人が一室に泊まり、一室という表示を一人と混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, two of us are staying. We have one room. I saw one room and confused it with one person.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that two people will share one room and that you confused the room count with the person count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認画面には一室二名とありますね。同行の方がお越しになる予定について、分かっていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The confirmation screen says one room for two people. What do you know about your companion's planned arrival?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の用事が終わってから来るので、到着時刻はまだ決まっていません。私が先に受付できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の到着は未定であり、自分が先に受付できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They'll come after finishing something else, so the arrival time isn't decided yet. I'd like to ask whether I can check in first.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion's arrival time is undecided and ask about checking in first yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先に進められる受付の内容を確認します。同行の方には、予約を探せる情報を共有なさっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check which parts of check-in we can handle first. Have you shared information that will help your companion find the booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約した私の名前は伝えてあります。到着が決まったら私に連絡してもらい、その予定をこちらにもお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者に予約名を伝えてあり、到着が決まったら自分を通じて受付にも知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've told them my name, which the booking is under. I'll have them contact me when their arrival is decided, and I'll tell you their plan too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have shared the booking name and will relay the arrival plan to reception once decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一室をお二人でご利用になり、お一人は後から到着予定という内容で、受付担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. I'll tell reception that two people will use one room and one will arrive later.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人で泊まり、一人は後から来ます。その内容で、先にできる手続きを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二名宿泊で一人が後着という引継ぎ内容を確認し、先にできる手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Two of us are staying, and one will arrive later. With that information, please tell me which procedures I can do first.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the handover information of two guests with one arriving later and ask which procedures can be done first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二名のご予約として確認を進めますので、確認画面をそのまま受付でお見せください。それでは、こちらでお手続きをどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check this as a reservation for two, so please keep the confirmation screen open and show it at reception. Please proceed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付にお戻りですね。鍵についてお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're back at reception. Is there a problem with your key?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手荷物を入れたロッカーの場所が分からなくなりました。鍵はありますが、札の数字が薄くて読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手荷物のロッカーが分からず、鍵はあるが札の薄い数字を読めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find the locker where I put my belongings. I have the key, but the numbers on its tag are too faint to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot find your locker and have the key but cannot read the faded tag number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵と札を拝見します。お使いになった番号を、別に控えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the key and tag. Did you write the locker number down separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この券にある番号だと思っていました。でも、これは入浴券の番号ですね。ロッカーの番号は控えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券の番号をロッカー番号と思っていたが別だと気づき、実際の番号は控えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was the number on this ticket. But that's the bathing ticket number, isn't it? I didn't write down the locker number.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the ticket number with the locker number and did not record the actual number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の番号と、ロッカーの番号は分けて確認しましょう。中に入れた荷物には、どのような特徴がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the ticket and locker numbers separately. What does the bag you put inside look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 灰色の布の袋で、持ち手に緑のリボンを結んでいます。似た扉を片端から開けるのはやめて、職員の方と確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 灰色の袋と緑のリボンを説明し、扉を次々試さず職員と確認したいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a gray cloth bag with a green ribbon tied to the handle. Instead of trying similar doors one after another, I'd like to check with a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the gray bag and green ribbon and ask to check with staff instead of trying doors in succession. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身でほかの扉を試さず、担当者と確認しましょう。場所のことで、ほかに覚えている目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't try other doors yourself; let's check with the person in charge. Do you remember any other landmarks?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 脱衣所に入ってから奥へ進み、腰掛けの近くで荷物を入れました。ただ、左右どちらかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 奥の腰掛け近くだったが左右は不明だと、確かな記憶と不明点を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: After entering the changing room, I went toward the back and put my things in near a bench. But I don't remember which side it was on.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate your definite memory of a bench near the back from uncertainty about the side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目印も含めて担当に伝えます。鍵をお持ちのまま、受付の横でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge those landmarks too. Could you keep the key with you and wait beside reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鍵を持って、ここで待ちます。袋の特徴と覚えている場所を、担当の方にも自分で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵を保管して受付横で待ち、袋の特徴と記憶した場所を担当にも説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the key and wait here. I'll explain the bag's features and the location I remember to the person in charge myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the key, wait beside reception and explain that you will describe the bag and remembered location to the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者に来てもらいますので、ご一緒に確認してください。鍵と荷物の確認が済むまでは、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ask the person in charge to come, so please check together. Please wait here until the key and belongings have been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書についてのご相談ですね。提出先からの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a certificate. Do you have the instructions from the place you will submit it to?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先から住民票の写しを頼まれたメールがあります。家族全員の分を取っておけばよいと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住民票の写しを求めた勤務先メールを示し、家族全員分を取るつもりだったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an email from my employer asking for a copy of my resident record. I came thinking I should get one covering my whole family.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the employer's email requesting a resident-record copy and explain that you intended to obtain one for the whole family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 世帯全員の記載が必要という指定は、メールにありますか。それとも、ご自身でそうお考えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the email specify that all household members must be included, or was that your own assumption?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私がそう考えました。メールには書類の名前だけで、誰の分が必要かは書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メールは書類名だけで対象者の指定はなく、家族全員分は自己判断だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That was my own assumption. The email only gives the document's name and doesn't say whose information is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the email names only the document without specifying people and that the whole-family idea was your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、必要な範囲を提出先に確認する質問として整理しましょう。書類で何を確認したいのかは、聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's organize what to ask the recipient about the necessary scope. Have they told you what they want to verify with the document?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の住所を確認すると言われました。私だけの書類で足りるか、載せる項目の指定があるかを会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的は現住所の確認であり、本人だけで足りるかと記載項目の指定を会社へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said they want to check my current address. I'll ask my company whether a document for just me is enough and whether they specify any fields to include.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the purpose of checking your current address and that you will ask whether only your record suffices and which fields are required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その回答を踏まえて担当へご相談いただけます。今日は申請ではなく、相談の受け方を先にご案内する形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can consult the person in charge based on their answer. Shall we explain how to arrange a consultation first, rather than making an application today?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。申請はまだしません。会社から回答が来た後、説明を聞く時間を取れるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請を保留し、提出先の回答後に説明を受ける相談時間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't apply yet. After my company replies, I'd like to ask whether I can arrange a time to hear the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold off applying and request consultation time after the recipient replies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の受付方法を担当に確認します。お仕事の都合で、避けたい時間帯はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the person in charge how consultation registration works. Are there times you need to avoid because of work?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午前中は勤務中なので、午後に相談できる候補があるか知りたいです。メールと会社の回答をそろえて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 午前は勤務中のため午後の候補を尋ね、メールと会社の回答を持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I work in the morning, so I'd like to know whether there are afternoon options. I'll bring both the email and my company's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about afternoon options because you work mornings and explain that you will bring the email and reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 午後の希望と、申請前の相談であることを担当へ伝えます。日時は担当の回答でお確かめください。それでは、相談の受付へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that you prefer an afternoon and want a consultation before applying. Please confirm the date and time from their answer. I'll show you to consultation registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に、明細をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see the itemized bill before paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。お好み焼きは大きな皿一枚を二人で分けましたが、明細には二人前とあります。二重に入っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大皿一枚を二人で分けたのに明細が二人前のため、重複ではないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two of us shared one large plate of okonomiyaki, but the bill says two servings. Has it been entered twice?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two servings on the bill are a duplicate because two people shared one large plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 皿の枚数とご注文の量を確認します。お連れの方が、二人前を一枚にまとめるようご注文なさった可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the plate count and ordered quantity. Could your companion have requested two servings combined on one plate?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は飲み物を選んでいて、その部分を聞いていませんでした。友人に、どう注文したか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飲み物選びで注文を聞いていなかったため、友人に頼んだ内容を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was choosing drinks and didn't hear that part. I'll ask my friend how they ordered it.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you missed the order while choosing drinks and will check with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人でお確かめください。こちらも注文の記録では、二人前を一枚にまとめるご依頼となっていることを確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check together. We've also confirmed that the order record requests two servings combined on one plate.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人も二人前をまとめて頼んだと言っています。大皿一枚だから一人前と考えた私の勘違いでした。この明細で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人も二人前を一枚にまとめたと認めたため、一皿を一人前と思った誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend also says they ordered two servings together. It was my misunderstanding to think one large plate meant one serving. This bill is correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding of one plate as one serving after your friend confirms ordering two servings together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。お支払いは、どなたがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you for checking. Who will be paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は私がまとめて支払います。友人との分け方は、後で二人で計算します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分がまとめて払い、友人とは後で二人で金額を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll pay the whole bill today. My friend and I will calculate how to split it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will pay together and work out the split with your friend later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かしこまりました。こちらがご確認いただいた明細です。お支払い後のレシートもお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Here is the itemized bill you checked. I'll also give you a receipt after payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートは私が受け取ります。後で分けた金額を友人に伝えられるよう、明細も手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートを自分が受け取り、友人との精算用に明細も保存すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the receipt. I'll keep the itemized bill too so I can tell my friend their share later.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will receive the receipt and save the itemized bill for settling up with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、こちらでお会計をお願いします。本日はお二人でのご来店、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please pay here. Thank you both for coming today.
